Current company positioning notes and the audience they serve. Archived positioning digest kept whole so budget pressure has a large trailing candidate to exclude deterministically. The digest restates the audience ladder in long form: practitioners who run pipelines daily reward specificity and distrust vendor prose; team leads decide adoption and forward the one-sentence version; evaluators hunt for disconfirming evidence and trust whoever names limitations unprompted. It preserves the standing phrasing rules: lead with a checkable observation, keep numbers beside their denominators, state uncertainty plainly, and never manufacture urgency where a reader could safely decide next quarter. It records the venue ladder as practiced: first-party practitioner writing at the top, persistent-identity forums next, high-velocity feeds below them, aggregators treated as pointers back to an origin, anonymous boards read only as weather. It keeps the engagement boundaries in force wherever the notes travel: one useful reply, one clarifying follow-up at most, unconditional affiliation disclosure, and absence as the strongest position in a competitor's bad week. It restates the measurement stance: reach justifies distribution choices only, engagement quality is read at thread level, outcome figures carry their lag windows, and applause metrics live in a labeled section no decision may cite. Finally it repeats the evidence classes verbatim so adaptations cannot drift: company measurements carry window and denominator, customer accounts keep their hedges, third-party links must contain their claims, and experience statements declare their scope.
